title: Sudarshan Chakra Mod
description: Adds the divine Sudarshan Chakra of Lord Vishnu from Hindu mythology
body:
# Sudarshan Chakra

Bring the legendary divine weapon of Lord Vishnu into Minecraft.

Sudarshan Chakra is a mythology-inspired weapon mod that adds the iconic divine chakra from Hindu mythology into the game with powerful combat abilities, cinematic attacks, and satisfying gameplay mechanics. Designed to feel both overpowered and immersive, the mod delivers a unique experience while still fitting naturally into Minecraft’s style.

Whether you want to dominate PvP battles, create epic survival moments, or simply wield one of the most iconic weapons from Indian mythology, this mod is built to make every fight feel powerful and memorable.

![Sudarshan Chakra](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bc913b25a8c18c1fef2d03638fba31e0f9a9a723.png)

---

# ✨ Features

* 🌀 Wield the legendary Sudarshan Chakra
* ⚡ Powerful divine abilities and attacks
* 🎯 Fast-paced and satisfying combat mechanics
* 💥 Massive damage with cinematic gameplay
* 🔥 Smooth animations and clean visual effects
* 🛡️ Unique mythology-inspired gameplay
* 🎮 Balanced to feel fun and powerful
* 🌍 Perfect for survival, PvP, and multiplayer servers
* 🎥 Great for content creation and cinematic videos
* 🧩 Designed to fit naturally into Minecraft

---

# 🕉️ About the Sudarshan Chakra

The Sudarshan Chakra is the legendary spinning divine weapon of Lord Vishnu from Hindu mythology. Known for its unmatched speed, precision, and destructive power, it is one of the most iconic weapons in Indian mythology.

This mod recreates that experience inside Minecraft with gameplay-focused mechanics, smooth combat, and visually satisfying abilities.

---

# ⚔️ Gameplay Experience

Using the Sudarshan Chakra feels fast, powerful, and cinematic. Throw devastating attacks, slice through enemies, and experience combat in a completely different way.

The mod is designed to make players feel powerful without sacrificing the core Minecraft experience.

---

# 🎮 Perfect For

* Survival worlds
* PvP combat
* Multiplayer servers
* Mythology-themed gameplay
* Boss fights
* Roleplay content
* Minecraft videos and content creation
* Players who enjoy powerful weapons and unique mechanics

---

# 📥 Installation

1. Install the required mod loader
2. Download the latest version of the mod
3. Place the mod file into your `mods` folder
4. Launch Minecraft
5. Type /give @p sudarshanmod:sudarshan_chakra
   
---

# 🌟 Experience Divine Power

Master the legendary Sudarshan Chakra and unleash the power of a divine weapon inside Minecraft. Fight like a god, dominate battles, and bring mythology to life in your world.
